cases.input: Render one structured knowledge artifact, one knowledge view and one knowledge map into an Obsidian note, Base and Canvas while preserving stable IDs and explicit relation types.
requiredBehaviors: preserve stable artifact IDs across all rendered representations
render only relations that already exist in the provider-neutral inputs
keep layout and view settings non-canonical
forbiddenBehaviors: derive a new domain relation from wikilinks or canvas proximity

cases.input: A user renames a note, moves it to another folder and draws a new Canvas edge between two existing nodes before candidate import.
requiredBehaviors: retain the original stable artifact identity despite file and folder changes
treat the newly drawn edge only as an untrusted candidate relation
emit a non-canonical candidate artifact for upstream review
forbiddenBehaviors: promote the manual edge directly to canonical knowledge
change artifact ID due to note rename

cases.input: An old Obsidian mirror still contains an active memory that is now superseded canonically; an import draft proposes last-write-wins because the mirror file has a newer filesystem timestamp.
requiredBehaviors: prevent stale projection from reactivating superseded state
route any semantic difference through the governed candidate/reconciliation path
forbiddenBehaviors: write canonical state directly from Obsidian
